figurative_meaning_en: Very easy; easy to understand or accomplish
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গণিতের সমস্যাটা জলের মত সহজ।
সে জলের মত এই কাজটা করে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: This math problem is as easy as water.
She accomplished this task like water – effortlessly.
note: The idiom draws from the natural flow and simplicity of water in Bengali cultural metaphors.
